pages.text: $(bold)Sweat drops$(): while Sweaty Feet, water droplets keep rising around your feet — the count scales with level and $(bold)sweat_particle_scale$() (can be disabled).$(br2)$(bold)Stink particles$(): green particles around the feet at sweat level 3, and around barefoot fungus-infected players.

$(bold)Sneezes$(): during foot fungus you sneeze every 60 ticks ($(bold)sneeze_particles$() can be disabled).$(br2)$(bold)Splash$(): water splashes, bubbles and puffs from washing, filling the basin, and rinsing boots — purely cosmetic, never affects the mechanics.
